title: [tenmin-redispatch] stopRecordForScanCancelled: characterization test for a record without an outcome or run id
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for stopRecordForScanCancelled in src/tenmin-redispatch.ts: no outcome record
- stopRecordForScanCancelled({ outcome: undefined, jobResult: "failure", chain: 3, githubRunId: "", finishedAt: "2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z", decision: { dispatch: true, nextAction: "continue", reason: "CONTINUE", nextChain: 4 } }, "991", "2026-10-06T10:00:20.000Z") is { outcome: { schemaVersion: "tenmin-history-outcome-v1", runId: "unknown", nextAction: "stop", reason: "STOP_SCAN_CANCELLED:run=991", rangesPlanned: 0, rangesSealed: 0, rangesRemaining: 0, madeProgress: false }, jobResult: "failure", chain: 3, githubRunId: "", finishedAt: "2026-10-06T10:00:20.000Z", decision: { dispatch: false, nextAction: "stop", reason: "STOP_SCAN_CANCELLED:run=991", nextChain: 4 } }

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v5): Peace's task (source: peace). stopRecordForScanCancelled is tested with records that have an outcome and a run id; a record with no outcome and an empty githubRunId (built outcome, runId unknown) and a string scan run id are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1fbe917, live 28-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v5); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with stopRecordForScanCancelled stubbed); suite 614/614 with all sixteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
